page.overview:
Who is Solence?

Solence was a male Human Sith Lord of the reconstituted Sith Empire. During the Cold War with the Galactic Republic, he served as an Overseer of Sith Academy on Korriban. Solence was killed when a Republic strike team was sent to secure Sith datacrons and artifacts on Korriban.
